description: Offline map moment: stylized generic SVG map (roads, park, water — city-agnostic, brand-token tinted) with a route polyline that draws itself (path-draw), origin/destination pins (node-pop) and an ETA chip. For on-her-way / store-finder / delivery-tracking beats. Swap the SVG layer for a licensed offline static map image at build time; never an online tile service.
